prompts.core: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent 4x4 character sprite atlas for RoomCrew 2.5D desktop office. Input image is REFERENCE ONLY: the cute round yellow hippo-like cartoon boy in the search results, not a screenshot to reproduce. Create ONE consistent cheerful male yellow hippo mascot: huge round orange muzzle, tiny rounded ears, two black round eyes, small orange rounded tuft on head, yellow body, orange shorts, short rounded feet and arms, no human hair, no text. Soft high-quality clay/toy 3D illustration with warm upper-left light, orthographic camera elevation 30 degrees, cozy office asset style. EXACT 4 equal columns x 4 equal rows in one square 2048x2048 RGBA transparent image, evenly spaced 512x512 cells, no grid drawn, each full body fully inside own cell, no clipped edges, same head/body size across ALL 16 cells, same grounded feet baseline at 88 percent of each cell, character height 350px in each cell, centered at 256px. Row1: four successive walking cycle phases facing front-right (screen down-right). Row2: four successive walking phases facing back-left (screen up-left, show back, muzzle mostly hidden). Row3: four successive walking phases facing screen right, clear side view. Row4: four front-right standing poses: neutral idle, happy waving to user, raising one hand to ask a question, talking with small hand gesture. Walking frames MUST move legs/arms, not just identical poses. Do not add chairs, desks, shadows, floor, background, other characters, borders, labels, UI, watermarks or props. True transparent background. This atlas is an initial directional keyframe preview; preserve strong identity and scale, do not improvise costumes.

prompts.rise: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production transparent character sit-to-stand transition sheet. Same character, exact same head/body size, orthographic 30-degree elevated rear-left view facing upper-left, same entire chair in every frame, same chair wheel-base center at 50% cell width and 90% cell height. Frame1 seated idle matching reference1 rear-left idle. Frame2 leans forward with hands leaving armrests. Frame3 lifts bottom away from seat with knees bending and feet coming off foot platform toward floor. Frame4 nearly upright in front-left of chair with feet touching floor. Frame5 fully upright in front-left of chair. Frame6 fully upright in same place arms relaxed, matching reference2 back-left stance. The CHAIR MUST STAY at the EXACT SAME scale/position throughout all six cells, NO movement/shrink/growth between frames, entire wheels visible. Actual feet move naturally from foot platform to floor, no floating. Leave enough room in each cell for standing big head, wide orange muzzle and whole chair. Large invisible equal cells, no grids, text, labels, shadows, background, particles, confetti, extra objects or extra sprites. Warm upper-left lighting, clean toy 3D look, true alpha transparency. Preserve foot platform and chair design. Wide 3:2 image. Reversing these 6 frames will be the sitting animation.
